test_title: PYST 2: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.

Every soldier and every officer was in their place.
solution:
The erroneous part is** their place i.e. this part has an error.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Replace '**their**' with '**his**'.
 
• 
 When **two singular nouns** joined by **and **are preceded by **each **or **every**, the pronoun must be **singular **in number.

 
 
• 
 **Every **soldier and **every** sailor **was **in his place.
 
 
 
 
• 
 Hence, the correct answer is **option 3.**

 
 

**The correct sentence**: *Every soldier and every officer was in **his **place.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information**__

 
• 
 **A personal pronoun** referring back to a **collective **noun must be in the **singular **number if the **collective **noun is viewed as a whole.

 
 
• 
 The jury has given **its **verdict.
 
 
• 
 The fleet will reach **its **destination in a week.
 
 
 
 
• 
 If the focus is on the** individual members **of the group, the pronoun should be in the **plural number.**

 
 
• 
 The jury **were **divided in their opinion.
